fields.pureModeHelp3dmigoto: Automatically injects the 3Dmigoto renderer when launching the game. Suitable for players who want to load mods.
fields.pureModeHelpPure: Launches the game without injecting any renderer for a clean vanilla experience.
fields.checkDllUpdateBeforeLaunch: Check for d3d11.dll updates before starting the game
fields.check3DmigotoPackageUpdateBeforeLaunch: Check for 3Dmigoto Package updates before starting the game
fields.preLaunchProgramsHelp: These programs start in order before the main launch flow begins. Each entry supports its own launch arguments and is always started through the shell.
fields.postLaunchProgramsHelp: These programs start in order after the target game process is detected. If the game starts slowly, the launcher will wait for about 30 seconds before continuing.
fields.dllSourceHint: Dev uses SpectrumQT/XXMI-Libs-Package, Play uses Doodle, and ssice-a uses ssice-a/XXMI-Libs-Package. After the first install, the DLL is cached locally and later mode switches only replace the local cached file. NTEMI is always forced to use ssice-a.
fields.availableDllVersionsHint: Fetched from GitHub Releases. You can install any listed version directly. The newest 10 versions are shown first.
fields.packageSourceHint: Automatically uses the Package repository for the current game preset. Any available version can be installed directly.
fields.noPackageVersionInstalled: No installed Package version is recorded
fields.availablePackageVersionsHint: Fetched from the GitHub Releases for the current game preset. The newest 10 versions are shown first.
fields.includePrereleaseUpdatesHint: When enabled, d3d11.dll and 3Dmigoto package update checks will also include GitHub pre-releases.
fields.wwmiConfigureGameHint: Before launch, update LocalStorage.db to disable ray tracing and apply WWMI-compatible game settings.
fields.wwmiApplyPerfTweaksHint: Write XXMI Launcher performance tweaks to Engine.ini. When disabled, those keys are removed.
fields.wwmiUnlockFpsHint: Set CustomFrameRate to 120 and lock it through LocalStorage.db, then update GameUserSettings.ini.
fields.wwmiForceMaxLodBiasHint: Set ImageDetail to Ultra High in LocalStorage.db before launch.
fields.wwmiDisableWoundedFxHint: Set SkinDamageMode to Off before launch to avoid texture issues after taking damage.
